translatedData.content:
ETH consensus draft introduces a new division of responsibilities | No firm commitment yet on finality timing | Staying disciplined around $2,400

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to chase ETH higher just because of a new EIP draft. On October 21, the Ethereum EIPs repository saw a proposal called “Decoupled Consensus,” which aims to separate voting on the available chain head from finality proofs. The author says its goals include laying the groundwork for a future transition to quantum resistance, improving fork-choice security, and shortening final confirmation times. The author also makes clear that many design details remain undecided and that the proposal is currently mainly seeking an EIP number. Its status is Open and Draft: it has not been finalized by developers, and the mainnet has certainly not been upgraded. What matters to me is that it treats “keeping up with the chain head” and “when a transaction becomes irreversible” as two separate engineering problems. If validated in the future, it could improve expectations around confirmation times for high-value transfers, cross-chain bridges, and institutional settlements. But there are still many hurdles between a draft and a specification, client implementation, testnet, and mainnet. We can’t turn imagined long-term efficiency gains into immediate revenue or buying pressure today.

This should also not be conflated with the current Glamsterdam testing schedule. The Ethereum Foundation has announced that Hoodi’s activation, originally scheduled for October 26, has been postponed, with no new date given. This shows that the rollout timeline is constrained by testing quality; it does not prove that the new consensus proposal has been included in that upgrade. On the market side, I found ETH/USD at Kraken trading around $2,405, with a 24-hour low of $2,357 and a high of $2,438. For now, the market looks more like it is digesting information within a range; there is no evidence that the draft alone drove this price action. Around $2,400 is just a reference point to watch, not an automatic buy signal. The upper end is $2,438–$2,450, and the lower end is $2,357–$2,360. If price holds above $2,450 on strong volume and retests without breaking below it, short-term risk appetite may be improving. If it falls below $2,357 and remains unable to reclaim that level, my range-based view is invalidated. If the draft is later withdrawn or substantially revised, its long-term narrative should also be reassessed.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. My tentative bias is conditionally bullish on spot, with a maximum position of just 3% of total assets and no leverage. I would consider entering in two parts only if ETH’s one-hour candle closes above $2,450, a retest holds that level, and the broader market is not weakening at the same time. The first target is $2,480 and the second is $2,520. I would take half off at $2,480 and protect the remainder around my entry price. The stop-loss would be below $2,420. If, after entry, price falls back below $2,450 and fails to reclaim it for two consecutive hourly candles, I would close early rather than wait for the price to hit the stop-loss. If price first breaks below $2,357, I would cancel this long setup and wait for a new structure and further official developments. I would not count an untriggered plan as a trade.

我的态度是谨慎观察，不因为一份新EIP草案就追多ETH。以太坊EIPs仓库10月21日出现“Decoupled Consensus”提案，拟把可用链头投票与最终性证明拆开。作者写明目标包括为未来抗量子过渡打基础、改善分叉选择安全性、缩短最终确认时间；同时也明确大量设计尚待确定，目前主要是在申请EIP编号。页面状态是Open、Draft，不是开发者已定案，更不是主网已经升级。我看重的是它把“链头先跟上”和“交易何时不可逆”拆成两个工程问题，若未来验证成功，可能改善高价值转账、跨链桥和机构结算对确认时间的预期；但从草案走到规范、客户端实现、测试网、主网还有多道关口，今天不能把远期效率想象折算成即时收入或买盘。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candlestick you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin’s price shoots up in a huge green candle, everyone in the chat is yelling “Buy!”, and your hand twitches as you chase in—only to find yourself holding
at the very top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a good look at that huge green candle that gets your heart racing: it’s the people who are already fully invested hoping you’ll chase in and take the other side
That is. Chasing after a sharp, high-volume rally is essentially providing liquidity for the holders who got in earlier.

A simple but effective rule: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback happens on lower volume and the price stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself a costly lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your principal back a second time.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Refuse to Cut Your Losses, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on paper look at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” But pay attention: that thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand right now.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and tune out the bad. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The cure is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” and act when that point comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and only then can you see clearly.

📰 Why Aren’t Hardware Wallets the Only Option? What Risks Do These 5 Bitcoin Storage Alternatives Actually Carry?

A CoinTelegraph report noted that, besides hardware wallets such as Ledger, there are five other ways to store Bitcoin, including ETFs, passkeys, and multisignature accounts. But each method comes with its own unique risks and trade-offs. ETFs, for example, rely on institutions to operate; passkeys can be stolen; and multisignature accounts are complicated to set up. This is a reminder to crypto users that protecting assets requires considering multiple factors—not putting blind faith in any single solution.

Why does this news matter?
Hardware wallet security is indeed constrained by supply-chain risks and physical damage. But in reality, most users compromise because hardware wallets are inconvenient to use. This news brings the industry face to face with a harsh truth: security is never a destination, but a dynamic trade-off. When users transfer Bitcoin out of Ledger and into an exchange (ETFs are still, in essence, exchange-based) or a wallet, they are accepting a trade-off: liquidity for security, or convenience at the cost of some protection. Why are regulators so keen to promote ETFs? Because hardware wallets cannot meet compliance requirements, and institutional investors need a regulated “safe cage.” This means that over the next few years, ETFs and hardware wallets will be “complementary” rather than competing, specifically: 80% of institutional capital will flow into the market through ETFs, while the critical private keys will still be managed by professional wallet providers.

Market impact
The impact on BTC will be reflected in the divergence in the nature of capital. ETF capital is incremental and stable, but it consists of “passive longs,” so its price volatility is lower than that driven by retail investors. When ETF assets reach $50B (currently around $5B), their liquidity needs could temporarily increase BTC volatility by 15–20%. The same applies to ETH, but passkey technology will accelerate its institutionalization, especially given that all 50 US states are promoting the preinstallation of key functionality in Web3 browsers. This means ETH will have a higher proportion of institutional capital than BTC, but its price will also be more elastic. Historically, a similar situation occurred at the end of the 2018 bull market. When exchange holdings surpassed 70% of capital, the market began to show signs of an unsustainable bubble.

Trading approach
For now, the diversification of Bitcoin storage methods suggests that price volatility will show “structural divergence.” If ETF assets grow faster over the next six months, BTC prices will gain firmer support, but this will not lead to a broad-based rally. This means $75K–$85K is a key range: below $75K, incremental ETF buying could be offset by institutional stop-loss orders; a break above $85K would require more evidence that institutional capital has reached a consensus. Simply put: the money hasn’t left Bitcoin, but it’s starting to resist piling entirely into the most popular hardware wallets.

📰 为什么硬件钱包不是唯一选择？比特币存储的5条替代方案到底隐含什么风险？

CoinTelegraph报道提出，除了Ledger等硬件钱包，还有ETF、通行密钥、多重签名账户等5种比特币存储方式。但每种方法都有自己独特的风险和取舍，比如ETF依赖机构运作、通行密钥易被盗窃、多重签名账户设置复杂。这提醒加密用户，保护资产需要多维度考量，不能迷信单一方案。

为什么这条新闻重要？
硬件钱包的安全性确实受制于供应链和物理损坏，但现实是多数用户因用起来麻烦而选择妥协。这条新闻点醒行业一个残酷事实：安全从来不是终点，而是动态权衡。当用户把比特币从Ledger转出，存入交易所（ETF本质仍是交易所）或钱包时，就等于接受了流动性换安全，或便捷性牺牲部分保护。监管机构为何大力推动ETF？因为硬件钱包无法承载合规需求，机构投资者需要的是有监管的"安全笼子"。这意味着未来几年，ETF与硬件钱包会形成"互补"而非竞争关系，具体表现为：机构资金80%通过ETF流入市场，但关键私钥仍由专业钱包管理。

对市场的影响
对BTC的影响体现在资金性质分化上。ETF资金是增量且稳定的，但属于"被动多头"，价格波动性低于散户行为。当ETF规模达到$50B时（当前约$5B），其流动性需求可能让BTC波动率阶段性提升15-20%。ETH同理，但通行密钥（passkey）技术会加速其机构化进程，尤其考虑到美国50个州正在推广Web3浏览器预装密钥功能。这意味着ETH的机构资金占比会高于BTC，但价格弹性也会更大。历史上看，类似事件发生在2018年牛市末期，当时交易所资金占比突破70%时，市场开始出现难以维系的泡沫。

操作思路
目前看来，比特币存储方式的多元化意味着价格波动将呈现"结构性分化"。如果未来6个月ETF规模增长加速，BTC价格会获得更坚实的支撑，但不会形成普涨行情。这意味着$75K-$85K是关键区间——低于$75K，ETF增量买入可能被机构止损覆盖；突破$85K，则需要更多证据证明机构资金已形成共识。简单说：钱没有离开比特币，但开始不愿意全部挤在最热门的硬件钱包里了。

Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts

Ethereum developers have called off Monday's Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi test network after security researchers identified a problem that could change how existing smart contracts handle failed transactions, potentially allowing errors to become permanent.

The upgrade was due to activate on Oct. 26 at 17:42:48 UTC. Developers postponed it during Thursday's All Core Devs Execution meeting to investigate how a proposed change to Ethereum's gas accounting interacts with contracts already running on the main network.

No replacement date has been announced.

The concern centers on EIP-8037, which changes how Ethereum charges for creating new records in its database. The proposal is intended to limit the growth of that database as Ethereum increases the number of transactions its network can process

Security firm ChainSecurity published an analysis on Oct. 13 showing that the change, combined with EIP-8038, could alter how contracts respond when another contract they call runs out of gas, or the fees used to pay the network’s operators

Some contracts are designed to catch a failed operation and continue processing. They may record that an attempt failed, disable further attempts or move to another step. Developers sometimes rely on the remaining gas being too low for those actions to finish, causing the entire transaction to reverse instead

Glamsterdam changes that calculation. Under the proposed rules, gas used to create certain records can be restored when those changes are undone. That can leave enough gas for a contract to complete a failure-handling operation that previously would have reversed

There is also a risk in the opposite direction. ChainSecurity calculated that creating a new storage slot could require 110,020 gas when a separate allowance is exhausted, compared with 22,100 under the old rules. A contract using an existing gas budget might fail while carrying out an otherwise valid operation.#Write2Earn #EarningsSeason #Ethereum $ETH

🛠️ Ethereum’s Glamsterdam testnet upgrade delayed: slower may actually be good news?

The Glamsterdam upgrade, originally scheduled to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, has been put on hold by core developers. A new date has not yet been announced.

The delay isn’t because “something went wrong.” Developers want to investigate one more thing: whether the new gas accounting method introduced by EIP-8037 could affect smart contracts already running on mainnet.

🔹 According to a news roundup on X, security firm ChainSecurity listed 13 examples and warned that some failed operations could become permanently stuck.
🔹 The planned increase in the gas limit to 200 million has also been postponed.
🔹 Wu Blockchain, CoinMarketCap, and several other outlets reported the news, citing the Ethereum Foundation as their source.

My take: the whole point of a testnet is to uncover problems there, not on your ETH. A few weeks’ delay on a testnet costs almost nothing; a stuck mainnet contract can cost real money.

But for everyday ETH holders, two things matter more:

First, you don’t need to do anything. A testnet upgrade doesn’t require you to exchange your coins, “migrate” anything, or grant any permissions.

Second, whenever upgrade news changes, fake “claim your upgrade” and “ETH migration” links start popping up. X users are already warning about this. Treat any “upgrade notification” that asks you to connect your wallet, sign something, or enter your seed phrase as a scam.

Timelines can slip; mainnet security can’t.

Do you think Ethereum’s “better slow than sorry” approach is prudent, or is it holding ETH back? Share your thoughts in the comments 👇

#以太坊 #ETH #Glamsterdam #OnchainSecurity

🛠️ 以太坊Glamsterdam测试网升级推迟：慢一点，反而是好消息？

原定10月26日在Hoodi测试网激活的Glamsterdam升级，被核心开发者按下暂停键，新日期暂未公布。

推迟原因不是"出事了"，而是要再查一件事：EIP-8037带来的新Gas计费方式，会不会影响主网上已经在跑的智能合约。

🔹 原计划一起推进的Gas上限提到2亿，也跟着延后
🔹 吴说、CoinMarketCap等多家同步报道，消息源指向以太坊基金会

我的看法：测试网存在的意义，就是让问题在这里暴露，而不是在你的ETH上暴露。测试网晚几周，成本几乎为零；主网合约卡死，代价是真金白银。

但对普通持币人来说，有两件事更实际：

第一，你什么都不用做。测试网升级不需要换币、不需要"迁移"、不需要授权。

第二，每次升级消息一变，假"升级领取"、假"ETH迁移"链接就会冒出来。有X用户已经在提醒这一点。凡是让你连钱包、签名、输助记词的"升级通知"，一律当骗局。

时间表会滑，主网安全不能滑。

Ethereum 的 Glamsterdam 升级不是什么普通补丁，它关系到 Layer 2 方案与主链的衔接效率。如果处理不好，未来大规模用户迁移时可能会出大事。这次推迟说明开发团队不希望把问题推向市场，宁可牺牲进度也要把安全关卡的。说白了，这不是小题大做，而是对稳定性的极致追求。在行业经历了这么多暴雷事件后，这种谨慎态度反而值得肯定。如果后续安全测试再出幺蛾子，那这个判断作废。

对市场的影响
虽然 ETH 短期确实受挫，但长期来看，这种主动求稳的举动未必是坏事。它至少证明以太坊团队还在认真对待技术问题，而不是为了进度盲目推进。对 BTC 来说，短期内可能会有人借机抛售 ETH 转向 BTC，但长期来看，如果以太坊能解决这个安全问题，它依然是数字黄金。更关键的是，这个事件会促使监管机构更关注智能合约的安全性审查，对整个行业都是利好。

操作思路
这次延迟更像是市场情绪的短期利空，长期来看反而可能是潜在支撑。但安全测试如果反复出问题，那整个生态的稳定性都会受影响。如果接下来看到安全测试彻底失败导致项目无限期搁置，这个判断就作废。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the story is always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, roll it over a few times,
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Rolling Positions Involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains
can vanish in just one or two big red candles.

【The Math】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

📰 A new Arbitrum play? Is the Developers Guild a money-making move—and a sentiment boost for ETH at $2.4K?

The Arbitrum Foundation has launched something new: a Developers Guild, which plans to distribute 2% of network revenue to capable development teams. So far, the Guild has only invited Arbitrum development team Offchain Labs, meaning they have first dibs on the money. The source of the news is Binance Square.

Why does this news matter?
The key point is that Arbitrum wants to provide ecosystem builders with more direct incentives. Competition among Layer 2s is heating up, and development teams are a key resource. Distributing revenue directly to teams is a stronger incentive than the previous indirect model of protocol revenue sharing. This suggests Arbitrum wants to accelerate technical development. After all, Offchain Labs is the sole member, which shows how heavily Arbitrum's technical roadmap depends on them. With ETH around $2.4K, this kind of community-building initiative could strengthen the Layer 2 ecosystem narrative and potentially lift sentiment.

Market impact
In the short term, this new mechanism could spark some community discussion while ETH is around $2.4K. Its long-term impact will depend on whether the Guild expands. If Offchain Labs remains the only team to benefit, developers at other Layer 2 projects may see this as unfair and move to other projects. If new development teams join in the future, it remains to be seen how long the ETH narrative can hold up above $2.4K. Market sentiment around ETH at this level is quite sensitive, so any community-building initiative could become a short-term catalyst.

💡 Arbitrum's move could boost sentiment around ETH near $2.4K in the short term, but its long-term impact depends on whether the Guild becomes an exclusive organization. If developers at other Layer 2 projects are unhappy, this mechanism could end up making Arbitrum less appealing.

What are “maximum fee” and “priority fee” in a wallet, and why is the actual amount spent often lower than the limit?
Definition: The base fee is burned and does not go to the validator who proposes the block; the priority fee goes to the validator who includes the transaction.
Why it works this way: With the base fee in place, wallets can calculate a reasonable fee directly based on on-chain conditions, so users don’t have to keep guessing how much to pay.
Under EIP-1559, the base fee paid for each Ethereum transaction is calculated using $ETH , and is burned.
Be extra skeptical of projects that promise consistently high returns.

Why are Ethereum gas fees split into a base fee and a tip?
Before EIP-1559, Ethereum used a first-price auction: users set their own gas prices, and the entire bid went to miners.
EIP-1559 went live with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: a base fee and a priority fee (tip).
When managing positions, the most important thing to remember is that the maximum fee shown in your wallet is just a cap. Check the on-chain record in a block explorer to see how much you actually paid.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Adding: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend right and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all-in from the start and adding to the max with unrealized profits is a fast track to the liquidation list.
A common sight. The right approach is called pyramid adding.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. Keep most of your cost basis low, so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn a profit into a loss. Once you lose your composure, all your trades go off the rails.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule everyone has heard to death but 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your original capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re basically finished.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out your position size.

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. Bitcoin has recently been hovering around $81,000, mainly because global stock markets have fallen while Brent crude prices have hit their highest level since March. Together, these factors have dampened risk appetite, prompting investors to seek safe havens. Bitcoin’s “digital gold” qualities have yet to come into play.

Why does this news matter?
The key point in this event is the divergence between oil and Bitcoin prices. Normally, rising oil prices would drive BTC higher because of its commodity-like qualities. This time, however, rising oil prices have instead weighed on the crypto market. This means the market is reassessing its approach to risk pricing: investors are now more concerned with whether there is “real inflationary pressure” than with whether there is “room for sentiment-driven speculation.” For the crypto market, this shift in positioning—from a “speculative playground” to an “alternative asset”—is the second major reshuffle since Q4 2023.

Impact on the market
This transmission mechanism shows that the global pricing system is undergoing subtle changes. Specifically:
- The impact on BTC is a short-term cooling in sentiment, but the long-term trend remains intact. $81,000 is currently the 50-day moving average support level. As long as this level holds, downside potential is limited.
- The impact on ETH is relatively delayed. ETH’s market cap and market-cap share are both lower than BTC’s, so a significant rebound is likely to come only after BTC stabilizes.
- In terms of fund flows, institutional investors are pulling out of high-volatility assets, but ETFs are still seeing net inflows. This explains why the decline has not been as steep as many expected.

Why are Ethereum gas fees split into a base fee and a tip?
EIP-1559 went live with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: a base fee and a priority fee (tip).
The more congested the network, the more the base fee increases, and the more ETH is burned. Compared with the amount of newly issued ETH, the amount burned determines whether the ETH supply increases or decreases during that period.
Under EIP-1559, the base fee paid for each Ethereum transaction is calculated at $ETH , and is burned. Currently 2405.09.
Don't rush into placing an order just because everyone around you is doing so.

Why is Ethereum’s gas fee split into a base fee and a tip?

With the base fee, wallets can estimate a reasonable fee directly based on on-chain conditions, so users no longer have to keep guessing how much to bid.

translatedData.content:
SEC Announces FY 2027 Examination Priorities | Tokenization Enters Clearing Risk Management | ETH: Focus Only on Real-World Adoption

My stance is cautious observation. I wouldn’t trade the word “tokenization” in a regulatory document directly as bullish news for ETH. On October 23, the U.S. SEC announced its examination priorities for fiscal year 2027, with the press release listing tokenization as one of the evolving market infrastructure risks. More importantly, the 20-page original report says examinations will cover clearing agencies’ default risk management, recovery and orderly wind-down, operations, and tokenization. For entities subject to Reg SCI, examiners will also focus on emerging trends such as securities tokenization, extended trading hours, and quantum computing. These are risk priorities for the examination program—not the passage of new rules, approval of tokenized securities, or a designation of Ethereum as a settlement network.

Why should ETH traders still pay attention? For regulated institutions to map securities interests onto a blockchain, the challenge is not just “issuing a token.” It also involves recordkeeping, custody, clearing, redemption, access controls, and incident response. By bringing these processes within the scope of examinations, regulators are signaling that projects must demonstrate that their operations and customer asset protections can withstand scrutiny. If regulated assets are eventually issued and settled verifiably on Ethereum mainnet or its L2s, that could potentially drive fee revenue, staking demand, or ecosystem usage. If all activity remains on closed ledgers, ETH may not capture any value. Concluding now that “the SEC supports ETH” or that “institutions will buy ETH” goes beyond what the document says.

We also shouldn’t force a causal link with the market reaction. As I write this, ETH/USD on Kraken is around $2,401, with an opening price of $2,386 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,357 and high of $2,415—still within the day’s range. There’s no evidence that this move was driven solely by this examination plan. More direct things to watch are whether the report’s language leads to specific rules or announcements of compliance projects, and whether fund subscriptions and redemptions continue—not just how many times a keyword appears in headlines. On price, I see around $2,415 as short-term resistance and $2,375–$2,357 as a support zone. A break below the lower bound would mean the current cautiously bullish framework should be withdrawn.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter immediately on the news. My directional bias would be for a small spot long position only. I’d consider a trade only if ETH holds above $2,415 on strong volume, retests $2,405 and holds, and there’s independent confirmation from capital flows or project developments. I’d risk no more than 4% of my total capital on a trial position, initially taking half off at $2,440, then closing the rest in stages around $2,470. If the price falls back below $2,390 after entry, I’d stop out immediately. If it first breaks below $2,357, I’d cancel the long plan and stay out of the market. If the price spikes on the word “tokenization” alone, without on-chain usage or formal disclosures, I’d rather miss the move than use leverage or add to a losing position. If the plan’s conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade—and no profit to speak of.

Sources: SEC FY 2027 examination priorities press release and original report; Kraken ETH/USD. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
SEC公布2027财年检查重点｜代币化进入清算风控｜ETH只看真实落地

我的态度是审慎观察，不把监管文件中的“代币化”三个字直接交易成ETH利好。美国SEC在10月23日公布2027财年检查重点，新闻稿把代币化列为变化中的市场基础设施风险之一。更关键的是20页原始报告：检查覆盖清算机构的违约风险管理、恢复与有序退出、运营和代币化；针对受Reg SCI约束的机构，也会关注证券代币化、延长交易时段、量子计算等新趋势。这是检查部门的风险安排，不是新规通过、代币化证券获批，更没有指定以太坊作为结算网络。

这件事为什么仍值得ETH交易者看？合规机构要把证券权益映射到链上，难点不只是“发行一枚代币”，还有登记、托管、清算、赎回、权限控制和故障处置。监管把这些流程纳入检查视野，意味着项目必须证明运营和客户资产保护能经得住审查。若未来真正有受监管资产在以太坊主网或其L2完成可验证的发行与结算，才可能带来手续费、质押需求或生态使用；若业务全部停留在封闭账本，ETH不一定捕获价值。现在就推导“SEC支持ETH”“机构将买ETH”都超出了文件内容。

市场反应也不能硬找因果。我写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2401美元，日开2386，滚动24小时低2357、高2415，仍在日内区间；没有证据表明这段波动由这份检查计划单独驱动。更直接的观察点是报告措辞以后有没有转成具体规则或合规项目公告，以及基金申赎是否持续，而不是只数标题里的关键词。价格上我把2415附近看作短线压力、2375—2357看作防守带；跌破下沿说明当前稳健偏多的观察框架需要撤回。

如果是我自己交易，现阶段不因新闻立刻参与，方向仅预设小仓位现货多单。只有ETH放量站稳2415、回踩2405仍守住，并看到独立的资金或项目进展佐证，才用总资金最多4%试单；目标先看2440减半，再看2470把余仓分批平掉。若入场后跌回2390，直接止损平仓；若先跌破2357，则取消做多计划，保持空仓。若价格只靠一句“代币化”冲高却没有链上使用或正式披露，我宁愿错过，也不加杠杆、不补亏损仓。计划未触发就是没有成交，更谈不上盈利。

来源：SEC 2027财年检查重点新闻稿与原始报告、Kraken ETH/USD。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaled Take-Profits: How to Lock In Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than setting a stop loss, because a stop loss cuts fear, while taking profits cuts greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaled take-profit strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】First stage: When the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell 1/3 to lock in some gains,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another 1/3. Third stage: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Close your entire position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you'll often ride the elevator all the way back to square one.

Liquidation data shows where leveraged traders were forced out, not where price must go next. I would wait for price-action confirmation and keep leverage under control rather than treating the heatmap as a standalone trading signal.

The Ethereum Foundation announced on October 22 that the Glamsterdam upgrade, originally scheduled to launch on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42 UTC (around 01:42 on October 27 in UTC+8), has been postponed. A new date has not yet been set. CoinDesk and Cointelegraph also reported the news that day. Security firm ChainSecurity pointed out that after the upgrade changes how fees are charged for “new ledger entries,” some older smart contracts may behave unexpectedly when handling failed transactions: errors that should have reverted the entire transaction could instead be permanently recorded under the new rules, while operations that should succeed could get stuck. The firm also identified more than a dozen examples of real-world contracts and is communicating with the relevant project teams through responsible disclosure.

After a meeting, core developers decided to investigate the issue before testing further. The official announcement was clear: this affects only the Hoodi testnet. Mainnet users and ETH holders do not need to take any action, and there is no indication that the mainnet is being exploited. Binance spot ETH was trading at around $2,409, virtually unchanged over 24 hours; the broader market was mixed that day, with BNB holding up relatively well.

The upgrade had already undergone an initial round of testing on Sepolia; Hoodi was to be the next public dress rehearsal. A planned increase in the testnet’s block capacity limit to 200 million was also put on hold. The new schedule will be announced by the Foundation. Safety first, then scaling—that is the core logic behind this pause.

📰 Why are traditional giants’ stocks being tokenized on Solana?

Securitize, a project focused on securities tokenization, has suddenly turned shares of major companies like Apple, Nvidia, and Tesla into tokens on Solana. This isn’t just a simple NFT hype play; it’s an attempt by blockchain to quietly gain a foothold in traditional finance. It won’t have much impact on ordinary investors, but it signals that blockchain technology is trying to tackle one of finance’s toughest challenges.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying reason is that Solana wants to become a bridge for traditional finance into Web3. Once shares of these major companies are tokenized, they could theoretically be easier to market-make and trade, and even use in derivatives. If this model works, blockchain could participate directly in the trillion-dollar market for stock issuance and circulation. This is similar to the earlier launch of Bitcoin ETFs: both use technology to lower barriers to finance. With regulators’ attitudes toward crypto remaining nuanced, this approach of “putting familiar things in a new container” may be an attempt to show regulators that blockchain is not a disruptor, but a complement to traditional finance.

Market impact
There’s no direct short-term impact on BTC or ETH prices, since stock tokenization has little connection to the underlying technologies of Bitcoin and Ethereum. Over the long term, however, if this model is embraced by mainstream financial markets, it could divert some funds to Ethereum or other public blockchains. Historically, similar developments—such as the earlier tokenization of XRP—had little initial impact, with effects only becoming apparent years later. This time, Solana is vying for a share of the market, and its high-performance capabilities could help accelerate the process.

💡 This means Solana is trying to move traditional financial operations on-chain with lower friction costs. But this thesis would no longer hold if regulators suddenly tightened their definition of security tokens, or if companies like Apple and Nvidia decided not to participate.

📰 More Americans now own Bitcoin than gold—what could this trend turn upside down?

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. A survey by River found that the share of Americans who own Bitcoin is now higher than the share who own gold. This shift could lead institutions to pay more attention to Bitcoin’s long-term value, and give the U.S. a stronger voice in the global crypto market. For ordinary people, it means more investment options—but it’s also worth watching out for the possibility that this trend could send Bitcoin’s price soaring all of a sudden.

Why does this news matter?
Behind it are two colliding trends: gold’s status as a safe-haven asset is being challenged by tech assets, and Bitcoin is a prime example of one. Why are ordinary Americans willing to move their money from gold to Bitcoin? Put simply, younger investors think Bitcoin offers better returns and is more convenient to trade. If this trend continues, it would mean that the foundation of demand for Bitcoin is becoming increasingly stable, rather than being driven purely by speculation.

Impact on the market
For BTC, this is a major boost to sentiment. Although prices could pull back in the short term as speculative money pours in, over the medium to long term, America’s more than 30 million Bitcoin holders could become Bitcoin’s “ballast.” The impact on ETH is relatively small, but as Bitcoin’s “little brother,” ETH could also benefit from this trend, as more people think, “If Bitcoin has surpassed gold, then ETH should have a chance too.” As a historical reference, before whales began accumulating Bitcoin in 2018, the share of U.S. retail investors holding it also went through a similar period of growth.

💡 This trend among U.S. retail investors could lead to a short-term rally for BTC. If the U.S. continues to report strong economic data over the next few months, the trend could intensify. 📰 美国人比特币持有人已超黄金，这股潮流到底要掀翻什么？

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。美国河岸调查发现，现在美国人的比特币持有比例超过了黄金。这个变化可能让机构开始关注比特币的长期价值，也会让美国在全球加密货币的话语权更重。对普通人来说，这意味着投资选择多了，但也要小心这种趋势会不会让比特币价格突然飙升。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这背后是两个趋势的碰撞：黄金作为避险资产的地位正在被科技资产挑战，而比特币刚好是科技资产的代表。为什么美国老百姓愿意把钱从黄金转移到比特币？说白了就是年轻投资者觉得比特币更赚钱，而且交易更方便。这股潮流如果持续，就意味着比特币的需求基础越来越稳定，不再只是投机炒作。

对市场的影响
对BTC来说，这是一个情绪上的巨大提振。虽然短期可能因为投机资金涌入而回调，但中长期看，美国这3000多万比特币持有人可能会成为比特币的"压舱石"。对ETH的影响相对小一些，但ETH作为比特币的"二弟"，这种趋势也会让更多人觉得"既然比特币都超过黄金了，那ETH也该有机会"。历史参考的话，2018年鲸鱼开始囤积比特币前，美国散户的持有比例也经历过类似的上升期。

💡 BTC可能会因为美国散户的这种趋势而出现阶段性行情。如果未来几个月美国继续公布强劲的经济数据，这种趋势可能会被放大。但要注意，如果美联储突然开始加息，或者监管政策转向，这个逻辑就站不住脚了。

For Coinbase, this is another stumbling block in its operations in Ireland.

Why does this news matter?
Ireland’s Central Bank is among the more aggressive regulators in Europe. Its action against Coinbase primarily targets inadequate measures to safeguard funds and lax controls over outsourcing risks. This means that even without a crackdown as severe as the one in the US, Europe’s regulatory environment is tightening step by step. Why does this matter? Coinbase is the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange. If it can’t get things right even in Ireland, will regulators in other countries be even stricter? That now seems quite possible. Ireland’s decision to impose this fine may only be the beginning.

Market impact
In terms of direct impact, Coinbase’s valuation in the Irish market could be affected, but this event is unlikely to cause major volatility across the global market. However, the news will certainly heighten regulatory anxiety in the cryptocurrency industry. Why? Because regulators are saying that crypto companies can’t rely on technology alone to ensure security; they need robust institutional controls. This means the cost of compliance for crypto businesses will continue to rise. For BTC and ETH, sentiment may fluctuate in the short term, but long-term trends will most likely still depend on market fundamentals, such as capital inflows and outflows and project developments.

Trading approach
This news has a limited impact on the market as a whole, but it is negative for the regulatory environment. There may be some risk-averse sentiment in the short term, but it is unlikely to be significant. If regulation continues to tighten, compliance costs across the industry will rise, which could lead some capital to flow out. If regulation truly gets out of control, more capital could flow in, but it’s too early to say. This means investors need to keep a close eye on regulatory developments, as regulation is the biggest external variable in the cryptocurrency market.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#资金费率 #情绪 #BTC #ETH

Short, but rather: be extra careful when going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major historical rallies started at times like this.

Ethereum announced the postponement of the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet due to security risks.
Latest News
Published
October 23, 2026
ChainSecurity said it had identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts that could potentially be affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes, and is coordinating responsible disclosure with the affected projects.

Ethereum developers postponed the Glamsterdam hard fork on the Hoodi testnet after researchers identified gas-related security risks that could affect how existing smart contracts handle failed transactions.

The Ethereum Foundation (EF) announced that the upgrade, originally scheduled for October 26, would be postponed to give developers time to investigate how certain proposals interact with smart contracts deployed on Ethereum.

On October 13, blockchain security firm ChainSecurity warned that two proposals included in Glamsterdam, EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, could weaken safeguards against a type of attack known as griefing through gas exhaustion.

The postponement raises uncertainty about the timeline for the Glamsterdam mainnet upgrade. Ethereum developers had been considering a launch in early December, with plans to set a final schedule after the Hoodi test succeeds.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts.
The two sides pay each other; the exchange only collects and distributes the money—it doesn’t profit from it.

[How it works] Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (sellers are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

translatedData.body:
Hashrate has hit a seven-month high, but are more or fewer names being written into the blocks? $ZEC

I counted the 1,059 blocks mined this week. Foundry USA took 278, or 26.2%; AntPool mined 215, or 20.3%; and F2Pool mined 174, or 16.4%. Together, the three accounted for nearly 63%. Add ViaBTC’s 8.6%, and the dozen or so remaining pools are left with the scraps. $ETH

The longer view is even more telling. Back in 2012–2016, it took seven named mining pools to account for half of all blocks. The largest four accounted for just 40.1%. Since the 2024 halving, only three pools have been needed to reach half, while the top four account for 72.1%. The figure was still 58.8% in 2020–2024. $SOL

The way blocks are signed has changed, too. Across all of history, 30% of blocks didn’t name a mining pool, mostly because they were mined solo at home in the early days. Since the halving, that share has fallen to just 3.2%. A hobby where no one signed their name has become an industry where almost every block carries one.

Concentration is even more pronounced over a short window. Of the most recent 144 blocks, Foundry USA accounted for 28.47%, AntPool 20.14%, and F2Pool 17.36%; another 9.03% couldn’t be attributed. The shares of the next few pools—SpiderPool, SecPool, Luxor, and Ocean—were all in the single digits.

The figures behind the new high need a closer look, too. The daily reading touched 1,024.96 EH/s, while the weekly average inferred from difficulty was 1,006 EH/s. The 30-day average was just over 11% higher than August’s 899 EH/s. Back in July, the entire network was down to around 726 EH/s—a 45% rebound in two months.

Mining equipment is indeed changing hands. Smaller operators are taking over machines freed up by publicly listed mining companies. The machines sit in their own facilities, but the blocks are credited to the top three pools. They pay the electricity bills; someone else gets the credit for the blocks. Ownership is spreading out while attribution is concentrating—a shift happening at the same time.

There’s also some hashrate that needs to find a new home. Binance Pool accounts for 1.2%, and with its shutdown scheduled for November 10, those machines will need to connect elsewhere. Will they move to the big pools or spread across smaller ones? Next week’s block attributions will tell.

After going through the numbers, my takeaway is this: the seven-month high means the machines are back, but the breadth of block attribution hasn’t returned with them.

Unit ambiguity found in ETH staking parameter | Proposal still under review | No chasing above $2,400

My stance is cautious and neutral-leaning. Today, PR #12575 appeared in the Ethereum EIPs repository, pointing out that a constant for the validator activation limit in the EIP-8061 draft, which is in the Last Call phase, is written as 256, even though the unit used in the calculation is Gwei. The author recommends changing it to the Gwei value corresponding to 256 ETH and using a Gloas-specific constant name to avoid a naming conflict with the old constant. Cross-checking the mainnet configuration in the Ethereum consensus specifications, the Gloas draft parameter is listed as 256000000000 Gwei, equivalent to 256 ETH, while the Gloas mainnet activation epoch has yet to be set. The important point here is that this is a “documentation specification consistency fix”—not that the existing Ethereum mainnet mistakenly set the activation limit to 256 Gwei, and certainly not that staking accounts were frozen today. The PR is still in Draft status, so the proposal should not be treated as an approved rule.

Why should ETH holders care? One goal of EIP-8061 is to improve the throughput of exits and validator consolidations while retaining the activation limit. Staking entry and exit efficiency can affect liquid staking products, validator operations, and investors’ expectations around lockup times. But mainnet adoption is still several steps away, including review, testing, client implementation, and a formal upgrade. Even if a parameter correction is accepted in the future, that does not mean the exit queue will immediately clear or that the ETH supply will suddenly change. In particular, amid widespread discussion of the Hoodi testnet delay, the Foundation has made clear that the Glamsterdam testnet activation originally scheduled for October 26 has been postponed, with no new date announced. I won’t conflate these two separate processes and claim that “the upgrade is complete” or that “the mainnet is having an outage.”

At the time of writing, the latest Kraken ETH/USD trade was around $2,409.55, with a daily open of $2,386.34 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,357.35 and high of $2,415.01. The price is above the daily open and approaching the top of the range; that is the market reaction observed so far. But there is no evidence that this rise was driven by a specification revision. My key levels are the $2,415–$2,420 upper-range confirmation zone, a pullback reference around $2,380, and the $2,357 lower boundary. If the price breaks out but quickly falls back below $2,380, the short-term bullish view is invalidated. If it breaks below $2,357, I would treat that as a downward shift in the range rather than continuing to use a draft proposal as a bullish rationale.

If I were trading myself, I would sit this one out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot long with the trend, risking no more than 2% of total assets on a single trade and avoiding high leverage. The entry trigger would be the price holding above $2,420 and then successfully retesting it, with confirmation that spot trading volume is following through; a single upper wick does not count. The first target is $2,460, where I’d take half off. If the remaining position stays strong, I’d then look toward $2,500. The stop-loss would be below $2,380 after entry. If Hoodi testing is further delayed or spot breaks below $2,357, I’d cancel pending orders and close any existing position. If the trigger conditions aren’t met, I’ll stay out of the market. A plan does not mean a trade has been executed.

我的态度是审慎偏中性。今天以太坊EIPs仓库出现PR #12575，指出处于Last Call阶段的EIP-8061草案里，验证者激活上限常量写成256，但参与计算的单位是Gwei；作者建议改成256 ETH对应的Gwei值，并采用Gloas专用常量名，避免与旧常量重名。交叉查看以太坊共识规范的主网配置，Gloas草案参数写的是256000000000 Gwei，折合256 ETH，而Gloas主网激活纪元仍未设定。这里重要的是“文档规格一致性修正”，不是现有以太坊主网把激活额度误设为256 Gwei，更不是今天发生了质押账户冻结。该PR仍为Draft，不能把提议当成已通过规则。

为什么值得ETH持有人看？EIP-8061的目标之一，是在保留激活上限的同时提高退出和验证者合并的周转能力。质押进出效率会影响流动性质押产品、验证者运营和投资者对锁定时间的预期；但它距离主网采用仍有审阅、测试、客户端实现与正式升级等环节。即使未来参数修正获接纳，也不等于退出队列立刻清零或ETH供应突然变化。尤其广场热议Hoodi测试网延期，基金会已经明确原定10月26日的Glamsterdam测试网激活推迟、尚无新日期；我不会把两件不同的流程拼成“升级已完成”或“主网出故障”。

写稿时Kraken ETH/USD最近成交约2409.55美元，日开2386.34美元，滚动24小时低2357.35、高2415.01美元。价格高于日开并逼近区间上沿，是已观察到的市场反应；但没有证据证明这波上行由一条规格修订驱动。我的关键位是2415至2420美元的上沿确认区、2380美元附近的回踩参考和2357美元的下沿。若突破后很快跌回2380下方，短线偏强判断被推翻；若跌穿2357，则应按区间下移处理，不继续拿草案当看多理由。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向只考虑现货轻仓顺势多单，单次投入不超过总资产2%，不用高杠杆。入场触发为价格站稳2420美元后回踩不破，并确认现货成交有所跟随；单纯一根上影线不算。第一目标2460美元，触及减仓一半，余仓若能维持强势再看2500美元；止损放在入场后跌回2380美元下方。若Hoodi后续测试继续延误或现货跌破2357美元，我会取消挂单、已有仓位平仓。没有满足触发条件就保持空仓，计划不等于已成交。

Ethereum’s Glamsterdam Upgrade Delayed at the Last Minute! Smart Contract Security in the Spotlight 

The Glamsterdam hard fork, originally scheduled to launch on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, has been officially postponed. A new activation date has not yet been announced.

Why the delay?
① Potential risks identified: Developers are investigating changes to gas fee rules, including EIP-8037, which could affect how existing smart contracts execute.

② Upgrades must do more than improve performance: Glamsterdam aims to increase Ethereum’s processing capacity, but it must also ensure that older contracts continue to work properly under the new rules.

③ No mainnet date set: This postponement applies to the Hoodi testnet. It does not mean that an upgrade failure has occurred on Ethereum’s mainnet, and there is no evidence that any related vulnerability has been exploited.

In a nutshell: An upgrade can wait a little, but security is not something to gamble with. Finding and investigating issues promptly on a testnet is an important part of Ethereum’s upgrade process.

📰 ETFs suddenly see net outflows, but BTC hasn't budged? This contradiction just got even more pronounced

We talked about this just two days ago. Now precious metals have crashed again, while BTC hasn't budged. Why have gold and silver shed $130 billion in four days, while Bitcoin remains firmly above $80K?

Gold and silver prices have recently been in free fall, losing $130 billion in just four days. This is linked to expectations of Fed rate hikes and inflation data, but on a deeper level, investors are rushing for the exits. Bitcoin, meanwhile, has seen a slight pullback, but at least it hasn't fallen below $80K—showing that BTC really is attracting safe-haven funds and dip buyers.

In-Depth Analysis

Why does this news matter?
The plunge in precious metals reflects the market pricing in bad news, but the key issue is where the money is flowing. Normally, in this kind of situation, funds would move into dollar-denominated assets, such as bonds or gold ETFs. This time, however, Bitcoin has shown remarkable resilience. This suggests that some funds are moving away from physical assets and traditional cryptocurrencies (such as Ethereum) and toward Bitcoin as “digital gold.” This may be because investors see bonds as too risky (the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield is 5.216%), while crypto offers a more flexible alternative.

Market impact
- In the short term, this strengthens BTC's relative advantage, but the long-term trend still depends on Bitcoin's own fundamentals. If the dollar remains strong, Bitcoin may need more positive catalysts to break above $80K.
- This means the market is reassessing crypto's safe-haven properties. If the Fed really does raise rates to the limit, whether Bitcoin can hold the $80K support level will directly affect its ability to replace some of gold's role.

Trading approach
Bitcoin didn't rise along with precious metals during their crash, but it didn't fall either, showing that this support level is critical. If the Fed strikes a hawkish tone next, this support could be tested. If Bitcoin actually falls below $80K, the story that previously attracted funds will have to be rewritten.

黄金和白银价格最近像坐了自由落体，四天跌掉1300亿美元。这跟美联储加息预期和通胀数据有关，但更深层是投资者在搞快跑。而比特币呢，虽然也有小幅回调，但至少没跌破80K，显示这个大饼确实在吸引避险资金和抄底者。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？
贵金属暴跌是市场在消化利空，但关键在于资金流向。通常这种情况下，资金会去美元资产，比如债券或者黄金ETF。但这次，比特币表现出了惊人的韧性。这说明一部分资金在逃离实物资产和传统加密货币（如以太坊），转向比特币这个"数字黄金"。这背后可能是投资者觉得债券风险太大（30年期美债收益率5.216%），而加密货币是更灵活的替代品。

对市场的影响
- 短期看，这强化了BTC的相对优势，但长期趋势还是要看比特币自己的基本面。如果美元持续强势，比特币想突破80K以上可能还需要更多利好。
- 这意味着加密货币的避险属性正在被市场重新评估。如果美联储真加息到极限，比特币的80K支撑位能否守住，直接关系到它能不能取代部分黄金地位。

操作思路
比特币在贵金属崩盘时没跟着涨，但也没倒，显示这个支撑位置比较关键。如果接下来美联储放鹰派言论，这个支撑可能被测试。如果真的跌破80K，那之前吸引资金的故事就要重写。

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position’s value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing an “Insufficient margin” alert,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: When losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

📰 Why are miners still chasing Bitcoin's rally? Herd behavior behind ETF buying

According to CoinTelegraph, new research from DWF Labs found that flows into Bitcoin ETFs largely follow Bitcoin's price movements over the preceding few days—buying when prices rise and selling when they fall. In other words, these investors are more like trend-followers than market leaders who determine price direction. This offers useful insight into how capital flows into the crypto market.

Why does this news matter?
This means that most of the money entering the Bitcoin market through ETFs does not actually contribute to price discovery. ETFs' open-ended creation and redemption mechanism lets retail investors participate just as they would when trading stocks, but DWF Labs' data shows that these investors are more like using real money to validate Bitcoin's recent volatility. From the perspective of market cycles, this is perfectly normal—chasing rallies in bull markets and cutting losses in bear markets are standard behavior. But for an asset as volatile as Bitcoin, this trend-following behavior means market sentiment can easily become polarized, while long-term capital based on fundamental analysis remains absent.

Impact on the market
Looking at the chain of effects, this is a short-term boost to sentiment around Bitcoin during periods of volatility—as long as Bitcoin maintains its upward momentum, ETF inflows will continue, creating a positive feedback loop. Over the longer term, however, the lack of value investors entering the market could cause Bitcoin's valuation to become detached from its fundamentals. Similar situations have occurred before. For example, near the end of the 2017 bull market, large numbers of retail investors entered through fiat-based tools such as MTCOIN, and were ultimately among the first to leave when the bubble burst. This means that if Bitcoin goes on to see a sustained, unexplained rise, ETF-driven trend-following buying could become a point where risk accumulates.

💡 I think this trend-following behavior will continue to intensify market sentiment while Bitcoin is in the $70K–85K range. If Bitcoin suddenly breaks above $85K and holds there, ETF inflows could accelerate, creating a retail frenzy similar to that of 2017. But if Bitcoin starts moving into a downward channel, ETF flows could suddenly reverse, since ETF investors themselves have no tools for short-selling.

据 CoinTelegraph，DWF Labs最新研究发现，买比特币ETF的钱流基本就是顺着比特币前几天的涨跌走的——上涨时跟着买，下跌时跟着卖。说白了，这帮投资者更像是跟风者，不是决定市场价格走势的引领者。这对理解资金如何流入加密市场有参考意义。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这意味着大部分通过ETF进入比特币市场的钱，其实并不具备价值发现能力。ETF的开放申赎机制让散户可以像买卖股票一样参与，但DWF Labs的数据显示，这些散户投资者更像是用真金白银验证了比特币近期的波动。从市场周期看，这很正常——牛市追涨、熊市割肉是标准行为。但对比特币这种波动剧烈的资产，这种趋势跟踪行为意味着市场情绪容易两极分化，缺乏基于基本面判断的长期资金入场。

对市场的影响
从影响链路看，这短期利好比特币在波动中的情绪面——只要比特币保持上涨惯性，ETF资金就会继续流入，形成正反馈。但长期看，缺乏价值投资者入场可能导致比特币估值与基本面脱钩。历史上有过类似情况，比如2017年牛市末期，大量散户通过法币MTCOIN等工具涌入，最终在泡沫破裂时也最先离场。这意味着如果比特币后续出现无法解释的持续上涨，这种由ETF驱动的趋势性买盘可能是风险积聚点。

💡 我看这种趋势跟踪行为在比特币$70K-85K区间会持续强化市场情绪。如果比特币价格突然突破$85K并站稳，ETF的资金流入可能会加速，形成类似2017年那种散户狂热局面。但如果比特币开始走下降通道，ETF的资金流可能会突然逆转，因为ETF投资者本身没有做空的工具。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What’s the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners pick one at random and end up suffering heavy losses.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market move, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
They support each other in the basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to your other positions or capital. The risk is locked in a cage.

title: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 被迫延期：gas 改动让失败路径可能被永久记录
subTitle:
以太坊主网升级踩了刹车。开发者取消了原定周一在 Hoodi 测试网上线 Glamsterdam 的计划，原因是审计机构 ChainSecurity 在 gas 机制改动中发现安全问题（Decrypt 10 月 22 日报道）。

风险是失败被永久记录：部分合约依赖 gas 检查与回滚，防止恶意方少给 gas 让操作失败。Glamsterdam 后，失败调用可能返还或补足 gas，重新定价也会改变需求，于是即使代码不变，原本会回滚的失败路径现在可能完成。ChainSecurity 称已找到 13 个真实案例，正联系受影响项目，基金会仍在评估范围。升级已在 Sepolia 上线，Hoodi 新日期未定，主网目标仍是 2026 年底。

个人观点：主动延期长期是好事，短期压升级叙事。币安 10 月 23 日 20:55 快照：ETH 报 2,403.82 美元（+0.125%），24 小时区间 2,360.32—2,417.77；多头触发条件是 4 小时收上 2,418 并回踩 2,390 不破，目标 2,450、2,480，止损 2,355；跌破 2,360 且反抽不过，看 2,320、2,280，止损 2,420。

translatedData.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade postponed: gas changes could make failure paths complete
translatedData.subTitle:
Ethereum’s mainnet upgrade has hit the brakes. Developers canceled the planned Monday launch of Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet after auditor ChainSecurity found a security issue in changes to the gas mechanism, Decrypt reported on October 22.

The risk is that failures could be permanently recorded: some contracts rely on gas checks and reverts to prevent malicious actors from underfunding gas and making an operation fail. After Glamsterdam, failed calls may have their gas refunded or topped up, while repricing will also change gas requirements. As a result, even with no code changes, failure paths that previously reverted could now complete. ChainSecurity says it has found 13 real-world cases and is contacting the affected projects; the Foundation is still assessing the scope. The upgrade has gone live on Sepolia, a new date for Hoodi has yet to be set, and the mainnet target remains the end of 2026.

Emergency brake on Ethereum!
Glamsterdam upgrade suspended due to a critical smart contract flaw

The technical roadmap of #Ethereum  has just hit a roadblock. Core developers decided to cancel the rollout of the highly anticipated Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet (originally scheduled for October 26) after security alarms were raised over how the proposed changes would affect existing smart contracts.

The trigger: ChainSecurity researchers published an analysis warning of critical anomalies in smart contract interactions under the new gas rules.

The proposals under scrutiny (EIP-8037 and EIP-8038): These measures aim to limit Ethereum’s massive state growth by restructuring the costs of creating records and gas accounting.

The main technical risk:
Permanent or altered failures: Many contracts are designed with emergency routines that rely on a transaction being fully reverted when it runs out of gas. Glamsterdam changes the gas refund calculation, which could allow failed operations to improperly complete error-handling processes.
Cost disparity: Creating a new storage slot could rise from 22 100 to 110 020 gas units, causing legitimate, well-functioning contracts to fail due to insufficient operating budget.

Scope of the upgrade: Glamsterdam addresses not only storage, but also introduces a new block builder selection system, improvements for handling larger blocks, and an increase in the gas limit to 200 million on Hoodi (also postponed).

Current status: During the All Core Devs Execution meeting, developers agreed to postpone the deployment indefinitely while they thoroughly investigate compatibility on mainnet. No replacement date has been announced yet.

Back when I owed 300,000 U, I’d calculate over and over before ordering takeout, and back out if it cost more than 20 yuan. Now my account balance is eight figures, but that habit hasn’t changed. People who’ve been poor understand: being able to control your impulses matters more than knowing how to read a bunch of indicators. #ETH 

Eight years ago, my startup failed and debt weighed so heavily on me I could barely breathe. At my lowest point, I even worried about where my next meal would come from. Later, I got into crypto. It wasn’t luck that got me through—I followed a strict set of rules, paid off my debts bit by bit, and gradually grew my account to eight figures.

First, choose a coin. Start with the daily chart and look at the MACD. Prioritize a golden cross, ideally one above the zero line. Don’t pay much attention to other indicators; the more you look at, the more confused you get. My view: the simpler the signal, the easier it is to stick to your plan.

Second, hold. The 30-day and 60-day moving averages are my bottom line. If the price is above them, I keep my position; if it falls below, I’m out. Don’t try to guess the bottom, don’t stubbornly hold on, and don’t make up stories to reassure yourself. If it breaks below the line, it breaks below the line.

Third, add to your position. I only consider adding when the price is holding above the moving average and trading volume is clearly higher than its recent average. If volume hasn’t picked up, I’d rather miss out. A lot of breakouts happen without volume. They look strong, but end up trapping people.

Fourth, sell. If it’s up 30% to 40%, take some profits off the table. If it’s up 70% to 80%, trim another portion. If it falls below the moving average, sell whatever is left. Even if the break is only confirmed the next day, get out. Don’t gamble on a rebound. Wait for it to climb back above the moving average, with confirmation from strong volume, before getting back in.

This strategy isn’t fancy; it may even seem a bit dumb. But for someone like me who’s climbed out of a hole, the priority is to survive first, then win.

八年前创业失败，债压得喘不过气，最难时连一顿饭都发愁。后来我钻进币圈，不是靠运气，是靠一套死规矩，把债一笔笔填平，账户慢慢做到八位数。

这套打法不花哨，甚至显得笨。可我这种从坑里爬出来的人，先求活，再求赢。

How do whales manipulate your mind? 
 1- Sell the News

Example - Popular coins: BTC • ETH • XRP
Whales sell on positive news

Real-life example:
 Positive news: Announcement of a major partnership or approval of an ETF - the price rises quickly due to optimism. Whales gradually sell as the price rises, while small traders buy in late. Then the price crashes, and latecomers lose.

Whale psychology:
 Goal: Make a huge profit by selling into a wave of optimism. They exploit FOMO and greed to move the market.

Reasons - How the effect happens:
> • Huge liquidity allows them to sell without an immediate crash
> • Amplifying news through social media to create excitement
> • Making traders believe the uptrend will continue to encourage buying

Steps to protect yourself:
 1- Check before you decide - verify the news with a reliable official source
 2- Don't chase candles - avoid buying at the top amid the hype
 3- Protect your capital with a plan in advance

Brothers! Turning 1,000U into more through compounding—I only follow these six steps #ETH 

Two years ago, one of my followers started with 1,000U, hoping to double it in three days. A week later, he had just 400U left. Then he started following the rules and taking things slowly. Two months later, he had grown it to 6,800U. It wasn’t because he had some magical trading technique—he’d finally learned to stick to a plan. If you want to grow 1,000U into 5,000U or 10,000U, don’t dream of getting rich overnight. First, focus on staying in the game.

Step 1: Start small and learn from mistakes
With 1,000U in capital, put only 200–300U into each trade at first, and leave the rest untouched. Going all in with a small account can make you overconfident after one win and badly hurt you after one loss.

Step 2: Trade only what you understand
I look for just three things: clear support and resistance, alignment with the higher-timeframe trend, and a risk-to-reward ratio of at least 2:1. If even one condition is missing, I’d rather sit out. The market is open every day—you don’t have to trade every day.

Step 3: Set your stop-loss in advance
Limit each trade’s loss to 2%–3% of your total capital, or 20–30U. If your call is wrong, accept it. Don’t add to the position or double down to try to win it back. One stubborn loss can wipe out all your earlier work.

Step 4: Compound only when you’re profitable
Once you have unrealized profits, move your stop-loss up first to protect them. If the trend is still intact, use some of the profits to add to your position. If the market weakens, reduce your position immediately. Adding to a losing position is asking for trouble, and adding recklessly to a winning one can give your profits right back.

Step 5: Increase your position size only after reaching 3,000U
Once your account reaches 3,000U, you can increase each trade to 800–1,000U, while keeping the same risk limits. Forget the rules just because you’ve made a little money, and the market will quickly teach you a lesson.

Step 6: Withdraw some of your profits
When you’ve grown 1,000U to 3,000U, withdraw 500U first. No matter how good your account balance looks, if you haven’t cashed out, you could still lose it all.

Here’s my take: luck might help you get from 1,000U to 10,000U a few times, but discipline is what helps you hold on to it. There’s one rule to compounding: use profits to increase your opportunities—don’t gamble your principal with your life on the line. If you can be patient, wait for the right moment, and cut your losses, your account has a chance to grow. @Square-Creator-cb3052992550a

Three Southeast Asian central banks discuss digital settlement | Stablecoin cross-border rules move forward | For ETH around 2,392, first watch which blockchain is adopted

My view is to follow policy developments, but not to chase ETH higher just because of the word “stablecoin.” A trending discussion on Binance Square says Malaysia and Thailand are joining Singapore’s stablecoin initiative. The primary source is an October 23 announcement from the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS): Bank Negara Malaysia and the Bank of Thailand have joined BLOOM as policymakers. The three parties will work with financial institutions, payment networks, and technology companies to study the acceptance, exchange, and final settlement of different digital currencies in cross-border settings. The announcement explicitly covers regulated stablecoins and tokenized deposits, and includes identity verification, sanctions screening, and transaction controls in its scope. It describes the joint development of approaches and an operational framework—not the launch of a unified stablecoin by the three countries, and certainly not the designation of any particular public blockchain as the settlement layer.

This news is relevant to ETH, but the transmission chain is long. If institutions eventually choose Ethereum mainnet or its L2s to process compliant digital currencies, usage could drive transaction fees, demand for settlement assets, or L2 data demand. But “institutions participate in BLOOM” does not mean “institutions buy ETH.” The announcement lists existing participants such as Circle, Coinbase, and JPMorgan, but does not say that they will deploy cross-border transactions on Ethereum for this project. Different institutions may use permissioned networks, other public blockchains, or traditional payment networks. Earlier MAS remarks on digital finance also stressed that tokenized deposits and regulated stablecoins must meet requirements for settlement finality and reserve credibility. The policy direction is interoperability and compliance, not an endorsement of any particular token. My independent assessment: in the medium term, watch for verifiable pilot scale and technical architecture; in the short term, do not automatically assign ETH a higher valuation.

Current market conditions show no one-way move that can be confidently attributed to this announcement. At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,392.24, against a daily open of $2,386.34 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,357.35 and high of $2,415.58. The price is slightly above the daily open, but has yet to break above the short-term high near $2,415. Key levels to watch are $2,380, $2,400, $2,415, and $2,450: a break below $2,380 would indicate weak buying support; reclaiming $2,400 would be only the first step, with selling pressure near $2,415 still needing to be tested. If ETH falls below $2,375 and fails to rebound, my short-term bullish assumption is invalidated. If official pilot details later confirm a non-Ethereum route, I would also have to retract the inference that ETH benefits directly.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. My only directional plan would be a conditional, small spot long—not a high-leverage trade. I would enter a test position only if ETH first reclaims $2,400 and then holds above $2,390 on a retest, risking no more than 2% of total capital. I would take half off at the first target of $2,450, reduce the position further at the second target of $2,490, and stop out and close the entire position if the price falls below $2,375. If the price breaks below $2,375 first, the original plan is canceled; I would remain flat rather than switch impulsively to a large short position. If none of the conditions are triggered, I would not later describe the plan as a trade that was executed. The most important thing in news trading is not racing to react to a headline, but confirming whether there is actual on-chain deployment and whether fees and settlement volume accrue to the ETH ecosystem.

Sources: MAS’s October 23 BLOOM announcement and October 9 remarks on digital finance; Kraken ETH/USD snapshot at the time of writing. #MalaysiaAndThailandJoinSingaporeStablecoinInitiative #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

这条消息与ETH有关，但传导链条很长。若未来机构选择以太坊主网或其L2处理合规数字货币，使用量可能带来交易费、结算资产需求或L2数据需求；但“机构参与BLOOM”并不等于“机构买ETH”。公告列出Circle、Coinbase、摩根大通等现有参与方，也没有说他们在这个项目里把跨境交易部署到以太坊。不同机构可能使用许可网络、其他公链或传统支付网络。新加坡金管局此前关于数字金融的讲话也强调，代币化存款和受监管稳定币要满足结算最终性与储备可信度；政策方向是互操作与合规，而非给某种代币背书。我的独立判断：中期关注可验证的试点规模与技术架构，短期不给ETH自动加估值。

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，

形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；

translatedData.content:
On October 22, the Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam hard fork on the Hoodi testnet had been postponed, with no new date set. The market’s response: 2395.1, down 0.28% over 24 hours. If this is genuinely bad news, that’s a pretty underwhelming drop. If it isn’t, what exactly are the people selling today pricing in?

First, the part everyone skipped over: testnet delays are routine in the development process. Something that works on a devnet can hit client-compatibility issues on a public testnet and get pushed back. This is hardly a first in Ethereum’s history. What really affects valuation isn’t the timeline, but the reduction in the scope of the EIP bundle announced in the same update. If ePBS and the Blob scaling parameters are removed from this round, that affects the L2 data-availability cost curve and the rate of mainnet burn. The fork date determines the news cycle; the scope of the bundle determines the valuation model. The market is selling the former today and hasn’t priced in the latter at all.

The derivatives market offers direct evidence: the 8-hour funding rate is +0.0008%, or less than 0.9% annualized. This doesn’t mean “leverage is clean”; it means the derivatives market hasn’t paid anything for this news. A typical genuinely bearish setup is when shorts start paying to bet on further declines—the funding rate turns negative, open interest rises, and the drop accelerates. Right now, the rate is hovering near zero, the price is down just 0.28%, and 24-hour trading volume is 65.088 million… here, that’s 6508.8M USDT, with no unusual spike either. A drop driven by spot selling is entirely different from one driven by leveraged selling. The former means someone needs cash; only the latter means someone is betting on direction.

There’s another contradictory combination: 77.3% of accounts are long, yet the funding rate is only +0.0008%. With 77% of accounts on the long side, you’d expect funding to turn positive, but it’s hovering near zero. That suggests those longs are small positions—just directional bets—and that the marginal positions that actually determine the funding rate are on the other side, or haven’t entered the market at all. With $5.595 billion in open interest, the price isn’t moving and neither is the funding rate. That’s waiting, not choosing a side.

So what to watch next isn’t “when will the testnet restart?” It’s three more concrete things: First, how ready the Glamsterdam branches are across execution-layer and consensus-layer clients. Client upgrade readiness is far more useful than the hard-fork date; historically, delays have almost always been due to client readiness, not design. Second, the final Blob parameter values: whether the target and max are raised, and by how much. Those figures translate directly into L2 data-availability costs and mainnet burn. Third, the snapshot of the final EIP list. Where the scope is cut matters an order of magnitude more than a delay of a few weeks.

My view: this move is selling the headline as bad news, not selling technical risk as bad news. The fact that the leverage side hasn’t paid a cent in premium is the evidence. If subsequent updates confirm that the Blob parameters are still included, the price gap created by this delay will probably be filled. The real risk isn’t that the fork is three months late; it’s that a reduced bundle flattens ETH’s burn curve by another notch—and that can’t be properly assessed until the list is finalized. Position for the list, not the date.

The short-term risk is the news vacuum: the testnet schedule could change again, and the price is likely to become less sensitive to announcements like this each time. Don’t treat the first reaction as a template.

content:
10月22日以太坊基金会宣布 Glamsterdam 在 Hoodi 测试网的硬分叉延期、新时间未定，盘面给出的回应是 2395.1、24 小时 -0.28%。如果这是一条真利空，这个跌幅不太像话；如果这不是利空，那今天砸盘的人在给什么定价。

先说被所有人跳过的部分：测试网推迟在生产流程里属于常态，devnet 上跑通的东西到公共测试网撞上客户端兼容问题就往后挪，这在以太坊历史上不是头一回。真正影响估值的不是那条时间线，而是同一批信息里 EIP 打包范围被削减。ePBS 和 Blob 扩容参数如果被移出本轮范围，动到的是 L2 的 DA 成本曲线和主网燃烧的斜率；分叉日期决定新闻周期，打包范围决定估值模型。市场今天卖的是前者，后者一分钱没定价。

合约端给的证据很直接：8 小时资金费率 +0.0008%，折年化不到 0.9%。这个读数的意思不是“杠杆干净”，而是这条消息在衍生品市场里没有被付过钱。真利空的典型形态是空头开始为下跌付费——费率转负、持仓量抬升、跌幅放大；现在是费率贴着零、价格只滑 0.28%、24 小时成交额 6508.8 万…这里是 6508.8M USDT，也没有异常放大。用现货砸出来的跌幅和用杠杆砸出来的跌幅，性质完全不同，前者是有人要现金，后者才是有人要方向。

还有一个打架的组合：多头账户占比 77.3%，费率却只有 +0.0008%。账户数上七成七的人站多头，理论上该把费率推正，结果它贴着零——说明这七成七是小单、是方向表达，真正决定费率的边际头寸在另一边，或者压根没进场。55.95 亿美元的持仓量挂在这里，价格不动、费率不动，这是等，不是选。

所以接下来该盯的不是“哪天重启测试网”，是三个更硬的东西：一是各执行层与共识层客户端的 Glamsterdam 分支准备度，客户端升级率比硬分叉日期有用得多，历史上的延期几乎都出在客户端就绪度而不是设计；二是 Blob 参数的最终值，target 和 max 有没有往上抬、抬多少，这个数字直接换算成 L2 的 DA 成本，也直接换算成主网的燃烧量；三是最终 EIP 清单快照，范围砍在哪一刀，比推迟几周重要一个量级。

我的判断是：这一波是把标题当利空卖，不是把技术风险当利空卖，杠杆端没为它付一分溢价就是证据。如果后续 Blob 参数确认保留，这次推迟挖出来的价格缺口大概率会被填回去；真正的风险不在分叉晚了三个月，而在打包范围缩水让 ETH 的燃烧曲线又平一档——而这条得等清单落定才算得清。仓位押在清单上，别押在日期上。

短线的风险在于消息真空期：测试网时间表还可能再变一次，价格对这类公告的敏感度会一次比一次低，别把第一次的反应当成模板。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 USDT control 1,000 USDT, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Let me explain it in plain English today.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 USDT and use 10x leverage, you’re effectively controlling
a 1,000 USDT position. If the coin’s price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your initial capital. Conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your initial capital—remember, the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by around 10%, your initial capital is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It doesn’t
take a 10% drop to lose everything; a drop of around 10% is enough to wipe you out (the exact point also depends on the margin ratio).

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
USDT is essential for trading futures, but many people have never stopped to wonder why it’s worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, and it gives you 1 USDT, while placing the
dollars (and equivalent assets) in reserve. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can ask the issuer to
redeem it from the issuer. This “issuance-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
If the price occasionally deviates a little (say, to $0.999), arbitrageurs quickly step in to close the gap.
